turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Everyone online keeps saying I should weigh my flour instead of using cups. Is it really such a big deal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be. A cup of flour can vary a lot depending on how you scoop it. Packed down, you might get a quarter more than the recipe expects.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That would explain my dry muffins.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Very possibly. If you stick with cups, fluff the flour, spoon it in loosely and level it off with a knife.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could just buy a scale.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Honestly, that's easiest. They're inexpensive, and you can weigh everything straight into one bowl, so fewer dishes too.
